lc_person: André Pierre Marie Hubert Lardinois (1961–), professor of Greek language and literature at Radboud University; works include Tragic ambiguity, Wisdom in context and Making silence speak.
item_person: André Pierre Marie Hubert Lardinois (1961–), classical philologist, also identified as A. P. M. H. Lardinois and André Lardinois.

evidence.says: LC heading is Lardinois, A. P. M. H.; variants include André Lardinois and André P. M. H. (André Pierre Marie Hubert). Sources identify Tragic ambiguity (1987), Wisdom in context (1995), and Making silence speak (2001). Princeton University Archives information and the latter book’s data sheet support birth year 1961. The Sappho (2014) note identifies a Radboud professor of Greek language and literature. LC links VIAF 109442693, GND 1014625556 and ISNI 0000000081747237.

German and Italian labels give André Pierre Marie Hubert Lardinois; German aliases include A. P. M. H. Lardinois and André Lardinois. The English description identifies a philologist born in 1961. P244 is n86094307; VIAF 109442693, GND 1014625556 and ISNI 0000000081747237 all match LC. P569 gives 1961.

Radboud’s profile is headed Prof. A.P.M.H. Lardinois (Andre), identifies him as professor of Greek language and literature, and calls him André Lardinois in its account of his work on early Greek poetry and classical drama.
